confidence_notes: Cusco food and beer observations are recent but based on a small price sample. Hostel prices are starting rates, so annual typical rates are approximate; hotel anchors are holistic estimates. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated as multiples of local draft beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: No cross-city proxy used; food and drink anchors use Cusco-specific price observations. Accommodation estimates reflect Cusco's tourism demand.
